nature_language: 当前位置深圳。我一个人想去广州玩2天，预算2500人民币，住一间单床房，期间步行，酒店最好有桑拿，想去白云山看一下，请给我一个旅行规划。
nature_language_en: Current location: Shenzhen. I want to travel alone to Guangzhou for 2 days with a budget of 2500 RMB. I would like to stay in a single room, preferably in a hotel with a sauna. I want to visit Baiyun Mountain. Please provide me with a travel plan.
